summary.text: Kyle Austin is the Libertarian nominee for the open U.S. Senate seat. A Havre-raised pharmacist, farmer and owner of the pharmacy company Pharm406, he previously ran for Montana's eastern U.S. House seat as a Republican in 2022 and 2024. He says he is running on health-care overhaul, agriculture and smaller government.

paragraphs.text: Born in Havre, Montana, on the Hi-Line, and raised partly on his grandfather's farm; graduated from Havre High School in 2001.
Earned a doctorate in pharmacy from the University of Montana Pharmacy School in 2008.

Worked as a pharmacist for about 18 years, according to his own account, including traveling the state doing pharmacy work before founding Pharm406, an independent pharmacy based in Billings with an office in Butte.
Owns family farmland west of Havre where he has grown wheat, barley and canola; describes himself as a fourth-generation Montanan, farmer, pilot and small-business owner.

Ran for Montana's 2nd Congressional District seat as a Republican in 2022 and 2024, and says he switched to the Libertarian Party because he considers both major parties dysfunctional; he won the 2026 Libertarian nomination in the June primary.
